description: Delta-based rewards: reward positive CHANGES, not absolute state. Diversity/monotony penalties were REMOVED entirely (they punished the necessary idle action -- DO_NOTHING is correct ~99% of steps -- and dominated even the victory signal). Action collapse is prevented by action masking + delta rewards instead.

economic_progress.description: Delta rewards: awarded once per positive change

military_milestones.description: One-time rewards for military pipeline steps (boosted to guide hard exploration)

victory_defeat.description: Game outcome rewards - combat victory worth more than timeout

timing_thresholds.description: DERIVED at load time from config.py REWARD_TIMING_THRESHOLDS — values here are ignored
